Buying questions

Frequently asked questions about used cars

How many second-hand cars are available in Dubai?

Cars24 regularly lists a large catalog of second-hand cars in Dubai, with inventory across price bands, fuel types, and body styles.

Which are the most popular makes available?

Popular choices often include Nissan, Toyota, Hyundai, MG, Kia, and Ford, depending on price range and body style preference.

What documents should I check before buying a used car?

It is important to verify registration papers, insurance documents, history details, and seller support documents before completing a purchase.

What is the process for transferring ownership?

Ownership transfer usually includes paperwork verification, registration transfer, and payment of any relevant fees or taxes based on local requirements.
